description: Hi! I'm Alexander, a 2nd-year Software Engineering student at Ural Federal University. I did a frontend internship at T1 Innotech: built mobile layouts, fixed critical bugs and made the UI for an HR chatbot. I'm into AI and computer vision, and I like shipping a working demo fast with clean UX. Looking for: a backend dev (Python/Node), an ML/data person and a designer or product-minded teammate. Fully committed for the whole hackathon - let's build something great!
